definition: to take off your clothes and put on different ones
exampleSentence: I change my clothes after work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thay quần áo sau giờ làm.

definition: to put on different clothes
exampleSentence: I need to get changed before dinner.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần thay đồ trước bữa tối.

definition: to fasten your clothes with buttons
exampleSentence: Button up your jacket.
exampleTranslation: Cài cúc áo khoác lại đi.

definition: to open a piece of clothing by undoing the buttons
exampleSentence: He unbuttoned his shirt.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy cởi cúc áo sơ mi.

definition: to close a piece of clothing with a zip
exampleSentence: Zip up your coat.
exampleTranslation: Kéo khóa áo khoác lên đi.

definition: to open a zip
exampleSentence: She unzipped her bag.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy mở khóa chiếc túi.

definition: to fasten your shoes with the laces
exampleSentence: Can you tie your shoelaces by yourself?
exampleTranslation: Con tự buộc dây giày được không?

definition: to wear your shoes
exampleSentence: Put on your shoes. We are late.
exampleTranslation: Mang giày vào đi. Mình trễ rồi.

definition: to remove your shoes
exampleSentence: Please take off your shoes at the door.
exampleTranslation: Xin hãy cởi giày ở cửa.

definition: to dress in the special clothes for your school or job
exampleSentence: Students wear a uniform at my school.
exampleTranslation: Học sinh trường tôi mặc đồng phục.

definition: to fold your sleeves up above your arms
exampleSentence: He rolled up his sleeves and started to wash the dishes.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy xắn tay áo lên và bắt đầu rửa bát.

definition: to push the bottom of your shirt inside your trousers
exampleSentence: Tuck in your shirt before the photo.
exampleTranslation: Hãy bỏ áo vào trong quần trước khi chụp ảnh.

definition: to make your clothes flat and smooth with a hot iron
exampleSentence: I iron my clothes on Sunday night.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ủi quần áo vào tối Chủ nhật.

definition: to choose what clothes to wear
exampleSentence: I pick out clothes the night before.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chọn quần áo từ tối hôm trước.

definition: to choose clothes that look good together
exampleSentence: She matches her clothes with a scarf.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy phối quần áo với một chiếc khăn quàng.

definition: to wear less formal clothes
exampleSentence: Our office lets us dress down on Fridays.
exampleTranslation: Văn phòng cho phép chúng tôi ăn mặc giản dị vào thứ Sáu.

definition: to take off your clothes
exampleSentence: The children get undressed and go to bed.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ cởi quần áo rồi đi ngủ.

definition: to remove your coat
exampleSentence: Take off your coat and stay a while.
exampleTranslation: Cởi áo khoác ra rồi ở lại chơi một lát nhé.

definition: to put your coat on a hook or hanger
exampleSentence: Hang up your coat by the door.
exampleTranslation: Treo áo khoác lên gần cửa nhé.

definition: to close your belt around your waist
exampleSentence: He fastened his belt.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy thắt dây lưng.

definition: to wear a scarf around your neck
exampleSentence: I put on a scarf because it is windy.
exampleTranslation: Tôi quàng khăn vì trời có gió.
